consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during a statutory inspection on LA-7201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on LA-7201 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. LA-7201 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 8 November 2014 a regulatory notice was issued concerning LA-7201 at Cape Verity Export Terminal following a statutory inspection.
